mentions.name: React in Godot
mentions.description: A complete implementation of React for the Godot game engine, enabling UI such as HUDs and editor interfaces to be built with React instead of Godot's control nodes, which are cumbersome to work with. Planned for open source release; the migration of Breaka Club's HUDs and editor UI to it is planned. Still being optimized.
mentions.problem: Godot control nodes are somewhat cumbersome to work with for building UI.
